summary: Retested all 4 bug fixes from iteration_1 + the new Reset button feature + regression sweep. All CMS fixes verified end-to-end (backend pytest + frontend Playwright against public preview URL). 13/13 pytest passing (added 4 new cases: services/slash key, empty-string strip + doc delete, DELETE auth, DELETE ok). All test overrides cleaned up — content collection now empty, public site shows defaults.

issues: Repeating console error: '<circle> attribute r: Expected length, "undefined"' — some SVG is rendered with r={undefined}. Cosmetic (does not break rendering) but pollutes console; likely a Lucide/loader icon with a missing size prop.

action_items: OPTIONAL: track down the SVG <circle r=undefined> console error (non-blocking, cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/content/{page_key:path} strips empty-string values and deletes the document when all fields are empty — clean and idempotent. DELETE endpoint is a nice additional affordance.

ContentManager.save() now diff-based (only fields that differ from defaults AND are non-empty), so GET /api/content stays minimal — verified: after saving only hero_line1 the 'home' key contains exactly {'hero_line1': ...}.
Split useEffect (notice cleared only on pageKey change) fixes the toast-flash bug; toast still visible after 2.5s in all three save paths tested.
test_credentials: Admin key from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, sent via X-Admin-Key header and content-admin-key-input.
seed_data_creation: No lingering test data — all overrides created during testing were deleted (DELETE + explicit cleanup). GET /api/content returns {} at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CMS fully working. Verified: (1) service-page save via slash key services/ai-seo — PUT 200, DELETE 200, /services/ai-seo renders overridden intro + service-faq-1 shows overridden Q/A. (2) Homepage hero_line1 override renders on /, clearing the field + save reverts H1 to 'Your Brand, Growing' default. (3) content-success toast remains visible after save (>2.5s). (4) Saving only hero_line1 -> GET /api/content home={'hero_line1': ...} only. (5) content-reset-button hits DELETE /api/content/{key}, page reverts, 'contact' key removed from GET. (6) DELETE returns 401 without key, 200 with correct key. (7) Regression: /admin loads, /contact renders contact-page + info cards, /services/google-ads shows 4 default FAQs, homepage shows hero-section/why-us-image/testimonials 3 cards/header-cta/site-footer. Only cosmetic issue found: SVG <circle r=undefined> console warnings on multiple pages (non-blocking).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all previously-reported bugs are fixed.
